newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity's Hayes, COO of unit FMR Co, to retire.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity's Hayes, COO of unit FMR Co, to retire.

text.p: Fidelity Investments said Wednesday that William Hayes, chief operating officer of equity investments for Fidelity Management and Research Co, would retire by year-end.
"He has expressed to us that he will be retiring by the end of the year, most likely by the fall," Teri Kilduff, a spokeswoman for Fidelity, told Reuters.
Hayes, 62, also a managing director with Fidelity Investments, has worked at the fund company for 28 years.

His retirement follows last week's news that legal counsel Robert Pozen was named president of FMR Co and the sudden resignation of Hayes' assistant head of the equity division, Bart Grenier, to join another firm.
